title: Affine-open sections of an unbounded quasi-coherent resolution
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $V$ an affine open of $X$. Let $F,J$ be integer-indexed complexes of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], with every term of $F$ quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent] and $J$ K-injective [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. For a quasi-isomorphism $i:F\to J$, the termwise section map $\Gamma(V,i)$ is a quasi-isomorphism of $\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$-module complexes. The global-ring action is the restriction-of-scalars action of the presheaf [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex]. No covering, totalization, boundedness or quasi-coherence of the terms of $J$ is assumed; empty $V$ is included.

source.place: Tag 08C2, lemma-alternating-cech-complex-complex-ss, singleton affine cover; Tag 08BS for restriction and Tag 01XB for affine vanishing. TeX read from stacks/stacks-project master in sandbox scratchpad.

proof.text: For each degree, write homology as the cokernel of the induced map into the differential kernel using ShortComplex.homologyIsoCokernelLift. Kernel and cokernel closure show that this homology is quasi-coherent. Differential cokernels are quasi-coherent by cokernel closure alone; the full cokernel/image theorem is unnecessary.

Restrict each term, differential cokernel and homology sheaf to every affine W contained in V. Restriction preserves quasi-coherence. Apply subsingleton_H_succ_of_isAffine on W.toScheme to all three families, and feed the resulting vanishing hypotheses into affineBasisSections_isIso_derivedUnit.

Let S be native O_X(V)-module evaluation. Its derived unit is invertible at F by the preceding step and at J because J is K-injective. The morphism Q_h(i) is invertible since i is a quasi-isomorphism. Naturality of the unit makes Q_h(S(i)) followed by the unit at J equal to the unit at F followed by R(S)(Q_h(i)). The right side is invertible; cancel the unit at J. The derived localization reflects quasi-isomorphisms, so S(i) is a quasi-isomorphism.

Forget both native O_X(V)-sections and the prescribed global-ring section modules to abelian groups. The resulting complexes and their induced maps are definitionally equal. Both forgetful functors preserve homology, and the global-ring forgetful functor reflects homology isomorphisms. Hence the displayed section map is a quasi-isomorphism. This argument includes the empty open and imposes no hypothesis on the terms of J.

proof_origin.place: Tag 08C2, three basis acyclicity conditions; assembled in Lean using the derived-unit naturality square and exact conservative scalar-forgetting.
